8.5.3 J1939Rm_CheckReceivedComIPdu
[SWS_J1939Rm_00062]
Definition of callback function J1939Rm_CheckRe-
ceivedComIPdu ⌈
Service Name
J1939Rm_CheckReceivedComIPdu
Syntax
boolean J1939Rm_CheckReceivedComIPdu (
PduIdType PduId,
const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x28
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.
PduId
ID of the received ComIPdu.
Parameters (in)
PduInfoPtr
Length (SduLength) of the received ComIPdu and a pointer to the
data of the ComIPdu (SduDataPtr).
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
boolean
Shall be always true to ensure the ComIPdu is received.
Description
Reports a received ComIPdu. If this ComIPdu was requested via J1939Rm_SendRequest or
the SendRequest service operation, a request timeout for this request is stopped.
Available via
J1939Rm_Com.h
⌋
[SWS_J1939Rm_00079]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00171
⌈The J1939Rm_CheckReceivedComIPdu call back function shall only be available if
J1939RmUserTimeoutSupervision is set for at least one user.⌋
See section 7.8 for details.
See section 7.2.1 for error handling and section 8.1 for parameter checks.
